calculator.importConfirmMessage: Import will replace all data in this calculator document. You can undo afterward.
calculator.helpIntro:
• One expression per line. Variables (e.g. total = 100 * 12 or 100 × 12), line refs (line 1, 第2行), previous answer (上一行 / above / prev), unit shorthands (25k, 1.5万 as multipliers).
• Special `all lines` (Chinese: 所有行) collects numeric results from lines above the current line; use sum(all lines), mean(all lines), etc.; toolbar “Variables & stats” can insert it.
• When Live Update is off, press Enter or blur the line to refresh results.
• Use Templates, Insert function, and the AI sidebar to build or insert formulas.
calculator.helpSyntax:
• Use * / or × ÷; middle dot · between digits is multiplication; ≤ ≥ ≠ map to comparisons; Western thousands separators like 1,234.56 are stripped; natural phrasing like 单价 乘以 数量 or 10 除以 2 works; ‰ and ‱ are per-mille / per-myriad.
• Text in double quotes is appended to the result display only, not evaluated; keep multipliers unquoted.
• Comments start with //, @, or /*. In Settings, choose whether `#` is a legacy comment or a Soulver-style section heading. In heading mode, a lone `小计` or `subtotal` line sums numeric rows since the last heading/subtotal. Toolbar tree menu inserts subtotal/heading; ⌘T / Ctrl+T inserts a subtotal row.
• Settings: choose Chinese × ÷ for exported expression columns (TXT, CSV, Markdown).
calculator.helpFunctionsPointer:
• Available functions and syntax follow the Insert function menu and the summary injected into the AI sidebar (financial, math, statistics, lists with 1-based indexing and inclusive slices, spreadsheet-style aliases, syntax & references). Do not invent names that are not in that summary.
• List functions combine with `all lines`, cumsum, listCumsum, etc.; very long lists are clamped in the engine.
• Finance and date examples are in the summary; dates support today, tomorrow, 2024-01-01 + 7 days, etc.
calculator.workspaceErrorBoundary: The calculator workspace hit an error. Try again; if it persists, switch away and reopen the document or check the file content.
calculator.placeholder:
Enter expressions, e.g.:
100 + 200
100 "USD"
x = 50
x * 2
line 1 + line 2
calculator.aiHintDesc: Click quick actions above or type a question
calculator.inputPlaceholder: Ask a question… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline)
calculator.aiSystemPromptExtra:
[Calculator reply rules]
1. Function names and syntax must match the injected capability summary in this message; do not invent names not listed there (including Excel-style aliases—only if they appear in the summary).
2. Finance: pv is often negative in pmt; nper signs must match pmt conventions; ipmt/ppmt per starts at 1; xnpv/xirr dates must align with cash flows.
3. List helpers: indices and listSlice are 1-based (see the “Lists” section in the summary).
4. Equities metrics are mostly arithmetic and powers; align TTM vs annual with the user data.
5. Double quotes are for display suffixes only; keep 万 / k / m multipliers unquoted.
6. For pastable formulas use ```formula blocks, one executable expression per line.
